newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance posts higher net 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance posts higher net 1996/97.

text.p: Reliance Industries, India's largest private company, said on Tuesday its net profit rose to 13.23 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) from 13.05 billion in the previous year.

The petrochemicals giant said sales rose to 87.3 billion rupees in 1996/97 from 77.86 billion. It also announced a 1996/97 dividend of 6.5 rupees per share compared with a previous dividend of six rupees.

A Reuters survey of analysts' forecasts had centred on a fall in net profit to 12.06 billion rupees, but on Tuesday morning and the previous day, Reliance shares shot higher on speculation that the result would beat the 1996/96 performance.
The share was traded at 313.00 rupees on the Bombay Stock Exchange at 2 p.m. (0830 GMT), up 5.25 rupees from Monday but off early highs of 320.25.
The share rose almost 10 percent on Monday, gaining 27.75 rupees to end at 307.75.
